analyst.summary: PI Industries had a weak FY26 as a multi-year global slowdown in agrochemical exports hit revenue and profit, but the company remains financially very strong with almost no debt, and its newer pharma contract-manufacturing business is growing well. The most recent (June 2026) quarter showed a clear improvement over the prior quarter, an early sign the down-cycle may be ending. Given the balance-sheet strength and this recovery signal, we see this as a hold rather than a sell, while flagging that the stock is not inexpensive and needs the recovery to continue to justify its price.
